name: Semantic Scheduling Bottlenecks
description: Replaces the explicit constraint equations and mathematical subsets from the seed with their equivalent semantic scheduling scenarios (an isolated job makespan, a single-machine makespan without phase 2, and a single-machine makespan without phase 1). This forces models to deduce the arithmetic checks (p1+p2 > T, sum(p1) > T, sum(p2) > T) from the physical constraints of the scheduling problem rather than pattern-matching the explicit system of equations.
